description: For a business owner who was brought to ShearQuery by an agency: whether that agency can see their account health (read-only: connections, stuck drafts, failures, plan, audit score — never their customers' details), and switching it on or off with share: true/false. manage: true ALSO lets the agency manage their Google Business Profile — draft and publish changes directly, with an email to the owner for every published or undone change; manage: false drops back to view-only. Only change either when the owner asks to.

manage.description: true to also let the agency manage (and publish to) the Google profile; false for view-only.

share.description: true to let the agency see, false to stop everything. Leave out to just check.

name: my_agency_access
title: Whether my agency can see my account
